skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 4-hit combo to a single back-row target for 35% ATK DMG, and reduces the target's chance to inflict [Force Field], [Stun], [Injured] and [Internal Injury] by 50% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 4-hit combo to a single back-row target for 40% ATK DMG, and reduces the target's chance to inflict [Force Field], [Stun], [Injured] and [Internal Injury] by 50% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains HP. After taking fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration] (while an ally is on the field, restores 15% HP before own next action to keep fighting, triggers up to 1 time). After acting, increases own DMG reduction by 30% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains HP. After taking fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration] (while an ally is on the field, restores 15% HP before own next action to keep fighting, triggers up to 2 times). After acting, increases own DMG reduction by 35% for 2 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains HP. After taking fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration] (while an ally is on the field, restores 15% HP before own next action to keep fighting, triggers up to 2 times). After acting, increases own DMG reduction by 40% for 2 turns.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
Restores Health over time or before the unit's next action.
